chapter_seo_title: Breaking the Cocoon - A Blood Servant Emerges Half-Transformed | RMJI Chapter 324
chapter_meta_description: The blood cocoons finally break, but the Ice Fiend emerges only half-transformed. Before the party can respond, a stealth murder claims their first victim.
og_description: The Ice Fiend breaks out early—half-transformed, still dangerous. One of the Yellow Maple Valley cultivators dies in an instant, her chest pierced through by an invisible hand.
twitter_description: A stealth kill shatters the party's formation as the Ice Fiend emerges from his cocoon—only half-demon, but already deadly.

lore_anchors.definition: A mid-grade metal-element mass attack technique that conjures thousands of tiny golden swords to rain down on a target. Metal-element offensive spells are extremely rare in the cultivation world.
A consumable talisman containing a fragment of a real magical treasure's power. It is a high-end strategic asset, usually inherited or provided by a powerful backer.

A forced, brutal process in which a blood cultivator's body warps into a hybrid demon form. A completed transformation is fully monstrous; an incomplete one leaves the subject partially human but still dangerous.
The blood servant responsible for the white, cold-style demonic transformation in this chapter. He emerges half-transformed, retaining intelligence but gaining claws, scales, and regeneration.
The literal act of a blood servant emerging from its protective light cocoon after completing (or aborting) its demonic transformation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t Han Li use his Talisman Treasure?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is deliberately conserving his strongest cards for the Black Fiend Leader, whom he knows is still waiting deeper in the battlefield. He views the blood servants as a manageable threat that his teammates can handle with their own high-grade assets.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did the Ice Fiend kill the senior sister so fast?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He used a cold-mist escape technique to enter a stealth or invisibility state, then struck while she was immobilized, channeling her Talisman Treasure. She had no way to defend herself.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is a half-transformed demon weaker than a full one?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not necessarily. A half-transformed demon retains human intelligence—making it more tactical—while still gaining significant physical enhancements like claws, scales, and regeneration.
